# Migration Constraint for VM bf8c824d-f099-4433-a41e-e3da7578262e

**Constraint:** Do not use live migration if the host has less than 2GB free RAM available. Instead, perform a cold migration by stopping the VM first before migrating it.

**Recommendation:** Before initiating any migration of this instance, verify the source host has at least 2GB free RAM. If available RAM is below this threshold, execute a cold migration (stop → migrate) rather than attempting live migration.
